narration: The halberd finds the lie before your boot does. Its blade passes through painted stone, then drops into an open sewer throat hidden beneath the false floor. You score a safe crescent through the rubble with the butt and cross it without testing your luck. The next court is failing in several directions at once: masonry falls upward before crashing sideways, rescue workers form a line beneath trapped windows, and something large hammers inside an iron cage.

payload.method: probed the illusionary floor from trusted rubble with the abandoned halberd
payload.objectiveRef: cross the false laboratory floor without falling
